tagline: Making thyssenkrupp an enabler of the green transformation.
hero_kpi_rationale: No distinct wow factor identified. The sector is industrial, not technological, so the selected master KPI is adjusted operational performance, key to industrial transformation and cost discipline.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total value of sales generated by the company after deduction of returns and discounts.
kpis.description: Net sales amounted to €37.5 billion in fiscal year 2022/2023, down 9% compared to the previous year.
kpis.signal: Declining revenue despite a challenging environment.

kpis.name: Order Intake
kpis.explanation: Total amount of new orders signed by the company during the year.
kpis.description: Order intake reached €37.1 billion, down 16%, reflecting a slowdown in demand.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBIT
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating result, excluding non-recurring items to better reflect underlying performance.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBIT dropped to €703 million (-66%), weighed down by margin pressures in materials services and steel.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from operations after investments, before merger and acquisition activities.
kpis.description: Free cash flow before M&A amounted to €363 million, a significant increase compared to the previous year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net profit or loss after taxes and financial charges.
kpis.description: The company reported a net loss of €1.986 billion, compared to a profit in the prior year.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the group.
kpis.description: The company employs approximately 100,000 people worldwide.

risks.title: Cyberattacks on critical IT infrastructure
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in Item 1A as subject of intensive evaluation by the Strategy Committee; interception of a documented real attack; ongoing IT measures reinforcement indicates active and persistent threat.

risks.title: Technology dependency for energy transition
risks.score_rationale: Central strategic positioning around Decarbon Technologies (nucera, Uhde, Polysius); nucera IPO July 2023 at €2.53Bn valuation; commercial success depends on technology leadership in hydrogen electrolysis and industrial decarbonation.

risks.title: Steel market volatility and automotive demand
risks.score_rationale: Steel Europe (€12.4Bn sales, €320M adjusted EBIT) and Automotive Technology (€5.5Bn sales) represent approximately 60% of revenues; dependency on automotive and construction cycles; major direct reduction (DRI) investment underway.

risks.title: Execution risks on separation plans (Marine Systems, Steel Europe)
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned as major Strategy Committee focus; partial separations underway (Marine Systems, Steel Europe); elevated operational and financial complexity; impact on cost structure and capital access.

risks.title: Environmental regulation and EU Taxonomy compliance
risks.score_rationale: EU Taxonomy Regulation mentioned as Audit Committee focus; reporting requirements under implementation; non-financial statement integrated into management report; risk of non-compliance with sustainability criteria.

risks.title: Raw material and energy supplier dependency
risks.score_rationale: Steel and electrolysis sectors highly dependent on iron ore, coal, electricity and hydrogen prices; geopolitical volatility (Russia, Ukraine) affects supply; implicitly mentioned via focus on energy efficiency.

risks.title: Litigation risks and complex regulatory compliance
risks.score_rationale: Audit Committee reviewed key legal litigations and compliance in detail; strategic compliance measures underway; group operates in 48 countries with exposure to multiple regulations (EMIR, WpHG, EU Taxonomy).

risks.title: Talent retention and leadership continuity post-CEO change
risks.score_rationale: CEO change announced late April 2023; initial cautious investor reaction; several Supervisory Board departures (Würz, Remmler, Sievers); major strategic transformation requires management stability.

ai_positioning.summary: thyssenkrupp does not mention any defined strategy or initiative related to artificial intelligence in the provided document. The focus is on green transformation and decarbonization technologies.
evidence: No mention of AI or AI-related APIs in the report.
Cited innovations relate to decarbonization technologies and sustainable materials.
The CEO emphasizes the company's role in the green transformation, not in digitalization or AI.
